answer_4.quote: We obtain 540 user-responses, based on 20 testset examples, balancing gold labels and model predictions to include 5 examples from each group: true-positives, false-negatives, true-negatives, and false-positives.
answer_4.guideline: Participants are asked whether the test example contains propaganda. Options included: definitely, probably, probably not, definitely not, or "I have no idea (completely unsure how to respond)". We compare the following four study conditions: No Explanation (Baseline), Random Examples, Explanation Only (EO), Model Prediction + Explanations (ME).
